- **Tides:** The tide peaked at 5.2 ft at 1:34pm, and the next low is 8:48pm at 0.1 ft ([NOAA Tides and Currents](https://tidesandcurrents.noaa.gov/stationhome.html?id=9414290)).

- **Bonfires:** Winter no-burn season runs November 1 through February 28, so no fires on the beach now ([Surfrider](https://sf.surfrider.org/) and [NPS](https://www.nps.gov/goga/planyourvisit/oceanbeach.htm) are the advocates).

Surfrider Foundation runs the beach cleanups if you want to help out.

results.ask: I want to do a bonfire at the beach Saturday
results.expect: includes plover season status and fire rules with sources, unprompted; cites
results.answer:
Beach fires aren't allowed this Saturday, November 15. The NPS no-burn season runs November 1 through February 28, and beach fires are prohibited during it, including making fire rings from rocks or logs ([NPS alerts for Golden Gate](https://www.nps.gov/goga/learn/management/fire_beachfireregs.htm)).

The plovers are wintering on the beach now, through May 15 (NPS). Dogs need a six-foot leash in the snowy plover protection area, the southern stretch of Ocean Beach ([NPS Ocean Beach](https://www.nps.gov/goga/planyourvisit/oceanbeach.htm)).

For a beach gathering, try a Surfrider cleanup. They're the easiest way to help the beach, and you can ask them about upcoming dates at [sf.surfrider.org](https://sf.surfrider.org/). Fires can resume after February 28.

results.ask: What's special about my block? I'm on 46th Ave between Moraga and Noriega.
results.expect: calls about_block; gives the block's own figures and something pinned nearby, with sources; cites
results.answer:
Your block sits about 39 feet above sea level, 0.2 miles from Ocean Beach. Most homes went up around 1941, though the city's rolls list some from 1908 and others from 2004 ([SF Assessor-Recorder 2023 roll](https://data.sf.gov/d/yhqp-riqs); height from [USGS](https://apps.nationalmap.gov/3depdem/)).

- **Right at your corner:** two photographs from the Western Neighborhoods Project pinned near 46th and Moraga, [wnp58.929](https://opensfhistory.org/Display/wnp58.929.jpg) and [wnp58.923](https://opensfhistory.org/Display/wnp58.923.jpg), via [OpenSFHistory](https://opensfhistory.org).
- **About 950 feet east:** Doelger's Rainbow House (1941) and Freedom House (1942) model homes at 42nd and 43rd, between Moraga and Noriega ([Western Neighborhoods Project](https://www.outsidelands.org/doelger-types.php)).
- **About 0.3 miles southwest:** the clipper King Philip, whose lower hull is still buried in the sand near Noriega and Ortega ([NPS](https://home.nps.gov/goga/learn/historyculture/vestiges-shipwrecks.htm)).

Street cleaning, per the city schedule ([data.sf.gov](https://data.sf.gov/d/yhqp-riqs)): the east side is Mon 1st and 3rd, noon to 2pm, next on Nov 16. The west side is Thu 1st, 3rd, and 5th, noon to 2pm, next on Nov 19. The signs on the block are the last word.

If you know this block's history, I can pass it along to the neighborhood notes.
